4-4.title: Production–dissipation balance
4-4.hypothesis:
A discrete energy budget uses prior E plus wind-cubed production and E^(3/2) dissipation terms. Coefficients absorb unknown length/time scales.

Development feedback available before this hypothesis: [{"attempt": "attempt-001", "group_MAE": 0.3173972561524605, "worst_group": 0.5982098856436229}]

This attempt tests a distinct explanation/ablation. All reserved groups remain unscored. A failure to beat the incumbent rejects predictive benefit rather than proving absence of the underlying physical process.

Decision rationale: Energy-plus-shear improves on persistence and flexible control. Test whether explicit production versus nonlinear dissipation better explains the dynamics.
4-4.equation: offset(input) + scale(input) * sum_j coef[j] * named_basis[j](input); all named bases defined in run.py; optional correction clipping/nonnegative output explicitly in state.
